rawContent: #BlackLivesMatter Don't forget about our Sister, Breonna Taylor! #BreonnaTaylor The murder of Black Americans is not a male only issue. Let's not treat it as such! #AhmaudArbery #

Black American women, DO NOT be fooled by other cultures and nations, or women outside of our community, holding up signs of #gregoryfloyd, but do not care to mourn the loss of #BreonnaTaylor #SandraBland #BlackTwitter #BlackLivesMatter What people think about your community and

culture relates to what they think about a people. If they are not crying and holding up vigils for #SandraBland #BreonnaTaylor, and so many of our Sisters, who have been murdered by police violence, then they do not care about Black America. #BlackLivesMatter #BlackTwitter

Many of them just want to use the deaths of Black American men as a cover up for their own racism, and sexism, against Black American women.  #BlackLivesMatter #SandraBland #BreonnaTaylor #BlackTwitter So, remember this Black American women, if other cultures and races of women

are not crying, or mourning the loss of our women, it means that they really don't care about Black America.  They just want to benefit from it. Use our men to gain entry, and move us out of the way. Remember this. #BlackLivesMatter #BlackTwitter #SandraBland #BreonnaTaylor

While we are talking about violence against Black Americans, it's very important for Black America to also have a serious conversation about violence happening against BA women and children, within certain demographics of our communities. This is very important. #BlackLivesMatter
